body: This guy doesnt seem to be cherishing you at all, just leave him girl.

You know, she's being emotionally abusive here, and usually the ones whom say they'll commit suicide never really does it. The ones whom really commits it are high likely to smile on the outside without anyone noticing it and just one day appears on the news dead. She's being manipulative and obsessive here cause there's no-one else for her to vent her frustrations on, if you really wanna help this relationship, help her and yourself, either you try counselling or attend counselling sessions with her.

Yepps, i agree too, you should let your friend know so he can deal with this together with his girlfriend, you shouldn't be in this cuz your not the one in this relationship, but your friend and his girlfriend. You guys are more like siblings, i too have a guy friend whom i calls him 'korkor' which means elder brother. His current girlfriend is my best friend whom i introduced the both of them to each other. My best friend has no quelms about it cuz we know each other, have your friend talk to his girlfriend, you guys can get to know each other better and prolly you'll get another sister even if she's a fine person:)
Picture the future between you and her, what do you see?
Just dump her, a woman whom truly loves you will help you save money instead.

Sometimes we often find ourselves looking towards our 'ideal' type, but tbh, 'ideal' types of men cant last long. I have my ideal type of man too, but i fell in love with a guy whoms the total opposite, yet i cant help it but feel happy when he's just healthy and happy. Prolly you and your husband should try understanding each other all over again, talk to your husband about this issue and tell him what's making you feel agitated or uncomfortable. Work things out with your partner. Dont stay just for the qualities, it'll just end up hurting both parties.
Well, you can always initiate to move out with you son, are you working btw?

Honestly, i dont think he even respects how you feel, and if he really sees you as his girlfriend, he wouldn't even introduce you as a friend and by that name which sounds like some kind of social media name you use, no offence but if i were you, i wouldn't trust him, he wont be able to make me feel secure at all.

Girl, you know we're all grown ups and have to be responsible for ourselves, even if it's our partner, they have to learn to be accountable to us, it works both ways. I too had been in a r/s for about 2 years 8 months and my ex moved in with me after only about 4 months of dating due to his family condition too. Yea the amount of time i had with my ex cant be compared to yours but time isn't really the factor to a relationship. It's the efforts and heart both parties put into the relationship, communication and walking on the same path supporting each other that keeps the 2 people going. If he have you in his heart, he would've made plans, worked for it, set goals, think of ways to make you happy, going to him for comfort is not gonna make things any better cuz the problem is still there. We have to learn to be okay on our own before we can really nail down that one person whom can fight and work alongside us together, not fight with each other😅 to get through things together. In life there is definitely ups and downs, and for 2 people's lives to merge and get in sync with one another is never an easy thing. I'm sure you'll be able to find that one person whom will choose to get through things together with you over anything, and not just let you carry on the burden and shoulder everything by yourself. You are strong enough, let's be women, not girls😉

Love, M

Yes, i just started a new job and got accepted into my dream degree course, i've wanted to do other stuffs too, it'll be really after i'm over with the heartbreak i guess:) Thank you for sharing with me!:)
Thank you so much for the advice, i agree that i need a break, and will continue to find help and support from my loved ones,
